note: Three hand-authored personas for the Post-Operative Report Clavien-Dindo grader. graderHint is set explicitly because bin/test-engines' discovery heuristic picks gradeOrder (the grade-key -> ordinal helper), not the composite. calculateClavienDindo returns { overallGrade, complicationCount, firedRules } only; detectAdditionalFlags (flagged-issues.js) is a separate export that form-app.js composes at render time, so the vital-sign / blood-loss / ASA / disposition / plan-gap flags are pinned here through flagsHint/flagsArgs (the Phase 13 tooling item, done 2026-09-03) - each description records the flags the persona would raise for cross-reference. Engine behaviour: overallGrade is the worst grade across complications whose 'grade' is a recognised key; entries with an empty grade are skipped entirely and do NOT consume a CD-n id slot's value but DO consume its index (ids are CD-<array index + 1>, so a blank entry in the middle leaves a gap in the id sequence); complicationCount counts graded entries only; when nothing is graded the result is grade-0 regardless of complicationsOccurred ('yes' with no graded entries still yields grade-0). Each fired rule's 'category' is the free-text complication description (or '(complication not described)') and its 'description' is the canonical Clavien-Dindo definition text for that grade. No timestamp is returned by this function. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas post-operative-report --update Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.additionalFlags via flagsHint "detectAdditionalFlags" with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectAdditionalFlags(state); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: Uncomplicated elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy
personas.description: ASA II day-case patient, 55-minute elective procedure, EBL 30 mL, awake and comfortable in recovery with normal observations, complete post-op plan. complicationsOccurred 'no' with an empty complications array. Expect overallGrade 'grade-0', complicationCount 0, firedRules []. Unpinned flags: none (no vital-sign, blood-loss, ASA, disposition or plan-gap trigger).

personas.name: Right hemicolectomy with ileus and wound infection - one ungraded entry
personas.description: Non-critical edge case: ASA III, 190-minute elective procedure with three complication entries, the MIDDLE one left ungraded (grade ''). Entry 1 is post-operative ileus managed conservatively (grade-i), entry 2 is an undescribed observation with no grade chosen (skipped), entry 3 is superficial wound infection needing IV antibiotics (grade-ii). Expect overallGrade 'grade-ii', complicationCount 2, and firedRules with ids CD-1 and CD-3 (the CD-2 slot is consumed by the skipped entry). Unpinned flags: FLAG-ASA-III (medium), FLAG-DISP-HDU (medium) - no vital-sign or plan-gap triggers.

personas.name: Emergency laparotomy with return to theatre and multi-organ failure
personas.description: Critical-highest persona: ASA IV emergency laparotomy for perforated diverticulitis with faecal peritonitis, 265 minutes, EBL 1800 mL with transfusion, hypotensive, tachycardic, hypoxic and hypothermic on ICU arrival. Three graded complications: transfusion for haemorrhage (grade-ii), return to theatre under GA for anastomotic bleeding (grade-iiib), and multi-organ dysfunction with ventilation + renal replacement therapy (grade-ivb). Expect overallGrade 'grade-ivb' (worst of orders 2, 4, 6), complicationCount 3, firedRules CD-1, CD-2, CD-3. Unpinned flags would be numerous: urgent FLAG-CD-IV, FLAG-BLOOD-MASSIVE, FLAG-VITAL-HYPOTENSION, FLAG-VITAL-HYPOXIA; high FLAG-CD-IIIB, FLAG-ASA-HIGH, FLAG-VITAL-TACHY, FLAG-VITAL-TACHYPNOEA, FLAG-DISP-ICU; medium FLAG-PROC-EMERGENCY, FLAG-DURATION-LONG, FLAG-VITAL-HYPOTHERMIA; low FLAG-PLAN-FOLLOWUP (follow-up plan intentionally blank).

additionalFlags.message: 1 life-threatening (Grade IV) complication — ensure ICU/HDU level of care and continuous monitoring.
Massive blood loss (1800 mL) — review haemoglobin, coagulation, and transfusion adequacy.
Hypotension (SBP 82 mmHg) on arrival in recovery — assess volume status and bleeding.
Oxygen desaturation (SpO2 90%) — escalate, supplement oxygen and review airway.
1 complication requiring intervention under general anaesthesia (Grade IIIb).
ASA class IV — patient at high peri-operative risk; ensure HDU/ICU disposition and senior review.
Tachycardia (HR 128 bpm) — assess for pain, hypovolaemia, or sepsis.
Tachypnoea (RR 26) — assess respiratory function and pain.
Patient transferred to ICU — ensure handover with ICU team.
Emergency procedure — heightened risk of post-operative deterioration; ensure close observation.
Prolonged procedure (265 minutes) — increased risk of VTE, pressure injury, and hypothermia.
